mapper.sql: e.*, t.completed, COALESCE(e.color, l.color, h.color, s.color, CASE e.kind WHEN 'anniversary' THEN '#e67e22' WHEN 'course' THEN '#1677a8' ELSE '#3b6ef6' END) AS display_color

FROM calendar_event e LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = e.task_id AND t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN task_list l ON l.id = COALESCE(e.list_id, t.list_id) AND l.user_id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN habit h ON h.id = e.habit_id AND h.user_id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN calendar_subscription s ON s.id = e.subscription_id AND s.user_id = e.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.subscription_id IS NULL AND e.kind IN ('task', 'habit', 'anniversary', 'course') AND (e.kind <> 'task' OR t.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY e.start_at, e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_event (user_id, kind, task_id, habit_id, list_id, title, note, start_at, end_at, all_day, timezone, rrule, color) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{taskId}, #{habitId}, #{listId}, #{title}, #{note}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{allDay}, #{timezone}, #{rrule}, #{color})
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_event SET kind = #{kind}, task_id = #{taskId}, habit_id = #{habitId}, list_id = #{listId}, title = #{title}, note = #{note}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, all_day = #{allDay}, timezone = #{timezone}, rrule = #{rrule}, color = #{color}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
